ac_dod_estimate.ac_coverage_note: 15 of 17 conditions measured. 2 BLOCKED with stated reasons and deliberately NOT counted as passes.

conditions.detail: Split to VCST-5670, which was verified and REOPENED the same day (VCST-5812). Leaving it as an AC here makes VCST-5632 unclosable.

conditions.condition: Modal closed with Escape returns focus to opener
Modal closed with close (X) returns focus to opener
Modal closed by backdrop click returns focus to opener
conditions.reason: Backdrop centre is covered by the dialog panel; the only ancestor whose centre lies off-panel has a zero-height box. Not measured and not claimed. Source suggests it routes through the same HeadlessUI onClose handler as Escape, but that is inference.

conditions.condition: Do not yank focus back when the user moved it (focusWasLost guard)
conditions.reason: The modal is a focus trap, so a user cannot place focus outside it while open. The reachable variant (Tab to Cancel inside the dialog, then Escape) restored correctly. The guard behaves correctly in every state a user can reach.

conditions.condition: Opener removed from DOM while modal open (isConnected guard)
conditions.detail: No exception, no focus on a detached node - both stated criteria met. Caveat: no fallback, so focus ends on <body>, the same end state as C2.7.

conditions.condition: Popup opened while focus was already loose on <body>
conditions.evidence_strength: Isolating A/B control: identical dialog, identical Escape trigger and dismissal, but with focus first on a textbox, restored correctly. The only difference is document.activeElement at open time - which rules out 'Escape-opened dialogs never restore' as an alternative explanation.

conditions.condition: Nothing behind a maximized blade is Tab-reachable
conditions.detail: Complete boundary proof rather than a 30-Tab sample: from <body>, Tab reaches the maximized blade's first control and Shift+Tab reaches its last, and DOM order places every background region before it. Pointer side confirmed - sidebar clicks are intercepted by the layout spacer.

conditions.condition: A VcPopover open before maximizing is covered by inert
conditions.detail: Exposure axis proven: axe scoped to .vc-popover finds applicable rules and a violation while .vc-app-menu is fully inapplicable. Tab axis NOT disproven, merely not constructible - this deployment has no notifications so the popover holds no focusable content.

conditions.condition: AI agent panel is inert under a maximized blade (#306)
conditions.detail: All four axe rules inapplicable, identical to the sidebar. Tab ring endpoint unchanged - the panel's Maximize/Close and its iframe are outside it.

conditions.condition: Mobile slide-out sidebar is inert under a maximized blade (#306)
conditions.reason: At 390x844 an open detail blade replaces the app bar entirely, with no Maximize control and no sidebar trigger. Maximizing on desktop then resizing also removed the app bar. The state 'sidebar open + blade maximized' is unreachable on this build.

conditions.condition: Covered content is not exposed to the accessibility tree
conditions.detail: Measured by scoped axe A/B'd against the restored state: .vc-app-menu and nav rules inapplicable while maximized, applicable again after restore. One named exception - the teleported popover (C3a.2).

conditions.condition: axe scan in the maximized state
conditions.detail: 1 color-contrast violation (5 nodes: environment-banner label, disabled 'Save as draft' label, en-US badge). Axe does not directly assert 'hidden content is not exposed', so C3b.1 is the primary evidence.

conditions.condition: [gap AC] Restoring a maximized blade removes inert again
conditions.detail: Sidebar search box clickable and focusable, Shift+Tab reaches 'Open menu', axe re-applicable for nav and .vc-app-menu. No one-way inert regression. No AC covered this.

conditions.condition: A modal traps focus (Tab cycles within it)
conditions.detail: Tab from Cancel wraps to the dialog's close control; Shift+Tab reverses. Trap works both directions (HeadlessUI).

conditions.condition: A maximized blade traps focus (Tab cycles within it)
conditions.detail: Measured: focus leaves the document toward browser chrome rather than cycling back. The implementer built this deliberately, arguing a non-modal region must not trap Tab (2.1.2) and that inert already satisfies 2.4.3/4.1.2. Recorded, not adjudicated - needs a decision from the accessibility-conformance owner. Nothing filed.

measurement_method.instrument: Playwright MCP accessibility snapshot [active] marker + Tab-continuation discriminator for focus; scoped axe.run(selector) A/B'd against the restored state for accessibility-tree exposure
measurement_method.instrument_correction: The orchestrator's brief specified testing a11y-tree exposure by checking that inert content is ABSENT from the Playwright ARIA snapshot. That is wrong - the snapshot does not model inert: with a blade maximized the sidebar still appears with full accessible names while having zero tab stops. The executing agent caught this and substituted scoped axe.run(selector), calibrated by A/B against the restored state (all rules inapplicable for a subtree = that subtree contributes nothing). This substitution is what upgrades AC-3b past the implementer's 'structural, not by listening' claim.
measurement_method.why_no_eval: The repo hook .claude/hooks/enforce-real-user.mjs blocks browser_evaluate/evaluate_script and has no allowlist pattern for document.activeElement. The @allow-eval sentinel is scoped to UI-fix/debug work, explicitly not test runs, so it was not used. axe.run() IS allowlisted, which is what made the scoped-axe substitution available.

open_decision_required.item: AC-4 - 'a blade or modal traps focus while open'
open_decision_required.state: The implementation deliberately contradicts the AC for a maximized blade. Measured: modal traps; maximized blade lets focus leave toward browser chrome.
open_decision_required.argument: A maximized blade is not a modal; trapping Tab in a non-modal region prevents reaching browser chrome (arguably a worse 2.1.2 violation), and inert on everything behind it already delivers what 2.4.3/4.1.2 require.
open_decision_required.needed: An explicit ruling from the accessibility-conformance owner. If accepted, rewrite AC-4 to the outcome ('a maximized blade does not trap Tab; everything it covers stays inert') rather than leaving a contradicted line in a ticket under test. Nothing filed.
